meta.title: Offers | Private, Semi-Private & Group Classical Pilates
meta.description: Private 1:1 Classical Pilates in person or online, semi-private sessions for 2–4 people, live group classes, and a Pilates community with Diana Gonçalves.

offers.cardPhotoAlt: Diana Gonçalves balancing on the wunda chair, leg extended
offers.oneLiner: Fully tailored Classical Pilates, in the studio or live virtual.
offers.title: Private Pilates 1:1 in person or online
included: Movement assessment and goal setting in your first session
Classical sequencing written for your body, history, and schedule
Real-time form correction, in person or on camera
Progress tracked and adjusted week to week
offers.description: One-to-one Classical Pilates in the studio or live virtual. Fully tailored to your body, your goals, and your history. Whether you're a beginner, advanced practitioner, or athlete.
offers.whoItsFor: For beginners building a foundation, advanced practitioners refining their practice, and athletes who want control, recovery, and longevity.

offers.pagePhotoAlt: Diana Gonçalves arched over the barrel, feet on the ladder, in black and white
offers.cardPhotoAlt: Diana Gonçalves holding the teaser position on the mat, in black and white
offers.oneLiner: Practise with a partner or friends, same attention, shared energy, shared rate.
offers.title: Semi-private Pilates (2–4 people)
included: Sequencing built for the group, scaled per person
Hands-on teaching for everyone in the room
A shared rate that makes private Pilates more accessible
offers.description: Small-group Classical Pilates for two to four people who want the same personal attention and tailored sequencing, with shared energy.
offers.whoItsFor: For couples, friends, or colleagues who practise better together.

offers.pagePhotoAlt: Diana Gonçalves in a single-leg stretch on the Pilates mat
offers.cardPhotoAlt: Diana Gonçalves folded over the wunda chair with one leg extended
offers.oneLiner: Live online classes and in-person group sessions for any occasion.
offers.title: Online and in person group Pilates classes
included: Minimal equipment; everything can be adapted
offers.description: Live online classes you can join from anywhere, plus in-person group sessions for celebrations, corporate events, or a private get-together. Perfect for bachelorette parties, birthday gifts, or friends who want to move together.
offers.whoItsFor: For beginners, advanced practitioners, and athletes who want structure and community, or any group of 5–8 people looking for a memorable, movement-filled experience.

offers.pagePhotoAlt: Diana Gonçalves balancing over the ladder barrel, legs in a split
offers.cardPhotoAlt: Diana Gonçalves balancing over the ladder barrel, legs in a split
offers.oneLiner: A free space for anyone curious about real Classical Pilates.
offers.title: Join the community
included: Weekly movement cues and exercise breakdowns
Direct access to ask questions and get guidance
Early announcements for classes, workshops, and free resources
offers.description: An online community for Pilates beginners, intermediate movers, advanced practitioners, and athletes who want to go deeper. Ask questions, share wins, get movement tips, and be the first to hear about new classes and free resources.
offers.whoItsFor: For anyone interested in Classical Pilates, no matter your level, background, or experience.
